[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Reed Bog | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=045 }} The [[Reed Bog]] is a circular area. Two paths circle around a depression filled with fetid waters. ==Getting there== Start from [[Ventari's Refuge]] and travel south through [[Ettin's Back]]. The secondary quest [[Dropping Eaves]] given outside Ventari's Refuge will lead here. == Shrines == ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s: * Northeast, near the exit to Ettin's Back. * Southwest, near the exit to [[The Falls]]. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== *{{x}} 1 (20) [[Elene the Vigilant]] ([[collector]] for 5 [[Ebon Spider Leg]]s) *{{x}} 15 (20) [[Scout Melthoran]] ===Charmable animals=== [[Animal]]s *{{x}} 5 [[Warthog]] ===Foes=== [[Arachnid]]s *{{r}} 16 (25) [[Maguuma Spider]] [[Plant]]s *{{r}} 19 (25) [[Redwood Shepherd]] *{{mo}} 15 (25) [[Life Pod]]s [[Scarab]]s *{{n}} 12, 16 (24, 25) [[Moss Scarab]] [[Troll]]s *{{w}}{{r}} 14, 18 (24, 25) [[Jungle Troll]] ==Notes== * Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.6% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. *{{Vanquisher|count = 85|low = 64|high = 107}} ** [[Minion master]]s should be aware that the [[Moss Scarab]]s will steal minions using [[Verata's Gaze]]. ** Most foes in the area are hidden. *** The northern path has many hidden [[Moss Scarab]]s. *** The southern path has many hidden [[Maguuma Spider]]s and [[Life Pod]]s. **With great patience, it is possible to bring a party of 8 from the [[Temple of the Ages]]. {{Explorable areas in the Maguuma Jungle}} [[de:Schilfmoor]]
